title: Certify integer div, mod, and abs in Lean through the clause log
summary: QF_LIA and QF_UFLIA inputs using integer div and mod by a nonzero numeral, or abs, are now exported through the clause log and certified in Lean, with Z3's arith axiom clauses proved as coefficient-free theory lemmas. Zero and nonconstant divisors stay rejected on every path to keep the soundness boundary explicit.
